articles.summary: Bloomberg: Nvidia CEO Says New OpenAI Investment May Be Largest Yet. “We will invest a great deal of money,” Huang told reporters while visiting Taipei on Saturday. Huang didn’t say exactly how much the company might contribute but described the investment as “huge.” “Let Sam announce how much he’s going to raise — it’s for him to decide,” Huang said, adding that Altman is in the process of closing the round.
